definition: Distilling a model into itself under a different context: the teacher branch is the same weights given a privileged input the student will not have at inference, and the student is supervised on its own rollout prefixes. Across 8 sources the framework is settled and the open questions are all about the coefficient and the context. On the coefficient: standard practice gives every local divergence the same weight regardless of position or of the divergence sequence it sits in, and the archived variants differ in what they weight by -- turn-level Bayesian belief updates, divergence-adaptive supervision horizons, reasoning-pivot tokens identified by the teacher's shift when a reference is added or removed, or hindsight-derived per-turn multipliers. One of them reports the useful null: unit-weighted dense supervision, which is what a method without allocation delivers, improves one metric by 6.4 points and yields no consistent gain on three others, so density alone does not explain these results. On the context: the corpus's options are a reference solution (specifies the target rather than the evidence), a skill card (no answer but no query-specific information), a completed trajectory with its verified outcome, or a retrieved evidence set -- and every source that tests it runs a scrambling control, because a privileged field must be matched rather than merely present. The standing limitation several sources list for themselves is that it requires a privileged teacher and so does not apply where none exists.

evidence.note: Re-scores a search agent's own sampled tokens under a teacher that has been shown the instance's supporting evidence, and uses the detached teacher-student gap to nudge the GRPO advantage up or down on search and answer tokens only, without adding a distillation loss or changing anything at inference.
evidence.title: EviSD: Evidence-Conditioned Self-Distillation for Search-Augmented Agents

evidence.note: Inserts a stage before RL in which the model extracts textual lessons from its own successful and failed rollouts, filters them by measured marginal utility on a held-out probe set, and distills the surviving pool into its own weights — so that GRPO starts from a policy that fails all-eight-samples less often.
evidence.title: Self-Improving Large Language Models via Progressive Experience Evolution

evidence.note: Turns token-level teacher-student log-probability gaps into turn-level credit for agentic RL by recursively updating a Bayesian belief in log-odds space, identifying pivotal turns without a critic.
evidence.title: AgentOPSD: Recursive Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning

evidence.note: Weights on-policy self-distillation supervision by how each local teacher-student divergence compares to the sequence mean, gating backward multi-step aggregation on that comparison.
evidence.title: DASH: Divergence-Adaptive Supervision Horizons for On-Policy Self-Distillation of Reasoning Models

evidence.note: Concentrates privileged self-distillation on reasoning pivots identified by the teacher's distributional shift when an English reference solution is added or removed, for multilingual reasoning transfer.
evidence.title: RP-OPSD: Reasoning-Pivot-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multilingual Reasoning Transfer

evidence.note: Gives the teacher in on-policy self-distillation access to each completed student rollout and its verified outcome, adapting it to preserve behaviour on successes and redirect failures toward verified success, while the student keeps a prefix-only interface it can actually deploy.
evidence.title: PAST: Privileged Adaptation from Complete Student Trajectories for On-Policy Self-Distillation

evidence.note: Gives the teacher branch of an on-policy self-distillation setup an abstract skill card -- a principle, when it applies, and the mistakes to avoid -- instead of the reference solution, so the privileged signal carries no answer and the gain lands on exactly the rollout groups where group-relative reward is algebraically silent.
evidence.title: Distill Skills into Weights, Not Prompts: Abstract Skills as Privileged Signals for On-Policy Self-Distillation

evidence.note: Profiles the dominant failure mode of an agent task family on development data, then freezes a policy that permits only the recovery interventions matched to that failure -- so a failure decides which repair is admissible and how much evidence to spend, rather than triggering more context indiscriminately.
evidence.title: Diagnosis Before Recovery: Turning Agent Failures into Selective Self-Correction

name: on-policy self-distillation
